title: Non-Invasive Detection of Right-to-Left Cardiac Shunts
official: Novel Approach for the Detection of Right-to-Left Cardiac Shunts
summary: This study will test the sensitivity of a novel, battery-powered, non-invasive ultrasound device to detect a right-to-left shunt
criteria: Undergoing clinically indicated TEE with bubble study for the detection of a PFO
